scope: Native C consumer of the exact unmodified upstream CoreStatic source closure under a DiskEd-owned build. No upstream scripts, installed SDK package, live lifecycle or shipped DiskEd integration.
consumer_restrictions: Reject every other command before creating a provider context; no arbitrary dispatch or apply path.
Always dry_run=1 and null setup-state, acceptance-root and activation; no lifecycle authority configured.
Read bounded request bytes from stdin; copy borrowed response bytes before the next provider call and context destruction.
A zero probe exit records an observation, not a successful supplier operation. Preserve C return, response status and JSON refusal/outcome separately.
required_checks: Four public C functions compile/link and actual ABI version, x64 layouts and size guards agree.
Caller-owned copies remain exact across next-command invalidation and context destruction; custom context allocator balances, without claiming all provider allocations use it.
Actual command graph and policy report available/read-only/planned state without granting lifecycle authority.
The exact qualified DiskEd portable ZIP is inspected read-only; archive size/hash, entry set and totals agree with the independent inventory.
A deflated fixture is inspected; this public inspector establishes structural metadata/hash, not payload CRC, decoded content or extraction correctness.
Malformed and over-budget archive/request shapes refuse without writes; raw supplier behavior is retained.
The generic DiskEd package/recipe fixture is refused by package.verify/audit because the pin requires FacMan metadata. No disguised FacMan identity or private fallback format.
Unconfigured read-only lifecycle planning refuses live_target_acceptance_required, leaving generated source/case/evidence/recovery fixtures exact.
Independent archive completeness verification remains required; an empty or content-corrupt archive inspection is not a package qualification.
Retain exact source blobs, build commands/compiler flags, native artifact/import observations and actual executions.
known_source_gap: runtime/setup/verify/usk_package_verify.cpp hardcodes facman.built_package.v1, facman.package_components.v1 and factorio_binding lock identity. Generic product-package/recipe schemas are not consumed by this verifier.
